rubric.why: This identifies a distinguishing property or unit of mass.
rubric.description: State a property or unit of mass.
rubric.how: Write that mass is the amount of matter in a body or give its unit, kilogram (kg).

rubric.why: This identifies weight as a gravitational force or gives its unit.
rubric.description: State a property or unit of weight.
rubric.how: Write that weight is the gravitational force acting on a body or give its unit, newton (N).

modelAnswer: Mass is the amount of matter in a body and is measured in kilograms (kg).
Weight is the gravitational force acting on a body and is measured in newtons (N).

items.followUp: Resolve a force of 20 N acting at 30° to the positive X-axis into its rectangular components.

rubric.why: This is the equation for the component of force along the X-axis.
This is the equation for the component of force along the Y-axis.

modelAnswer: The component along the X-axis is Fx = F cos θ.
The component along the Y-axis is Fy = F sin θ.
